name: esteem-cars
comment:webpack: Next 16 defaults to Turbopack, which needs the native @next/swc binary. Smart App Control is Enforced on this machine and blocks that .node file, so Next falls back to WASM bindings, which Turbopack cannot use. --webpack works on WASM. Drop these flags on any machine where the native binary loads (CI, Vercel) to get the faster Turbopack path.
